nodes.title: SG-1.1 Configure Tailwind and the UI stack in game/frontend
nodes.body:
Context: game/frontend has only react, react-dom and yaml in package.json; no Tailwind or PostCSS config exists and src/styles.css is plain CSS. Desired behavior: Tailwind is configured with design tokens, a cn helper exists, shadcn/Radix dependencies are installed and used, and Lucide/Motion are used by real UI. Expected result: the stack is exercised by shipped components, not only listed. Why: later SG-1 slices build the pixel-art shell on it.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given game/frontend, when the build config is read, then tailwind.config.ts and postcss.config.js exist and process src/styles.css
- Given styles.css, when read, then it contains the three @tailwind directives and design token CSS variables
- Given the cn helper, when called with conflicting Tailwind classes, then the last wins
- Given GameLayout, when rendered, then it uses a shadcn-style Button, a Lucide icon and a Motion element while the existing drawer behavior is unchanged


## Scope
- In scope: game/frontend package.json, Tailwind/PostCSS config, styles.css, cn helper, ui Button, GameLayout toggle
- Out of scope: Phaser, Zustand, header, modals, backend changes
- Preserve: Existing .game-layout/.story-panel CSS and drawer toggle behavior
- Preserve: Existing tests under game/frontend/tests


## Technical constraints
- Use Tailwind CSS with PostCSS in Vite
- Stay inside game/frontend


## Definition of done
- All requirements delivered and unit tests pass


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Tailwind and PostCSS are configured with design tokens and directives
nodes.body:
Context: no tailwind/postcss config exists in game/frontend. Desired behavior: Tailwind scans index.html and src, theme extends with token colors backed by CSS variables, styles.css starts with @tailwind directives and defines the tokens. Expected result: utility classes compile in Vite. Why: foundation for the design system.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given tailwind.config.ts, when imported, then content includes ./index.html and ./src/**/*.{ts,tsx}
- Given tailwind.config.ts, when imported, then theme.extend.colors maps background, foreground and primary to hsl(var(--...))
- Given styles.css, when read, then it contains @tailwind base, components and utilities and a :root block defining --background, --foreground and --primary
- Given styles.css, when read, then the existing .game-layout and .story-panel rules remain


## Scope
- In scope: package.json devDependencies
- In scope: tailwind.config.ts
- In scope: postcss.config.js
- In scope: src/styles.css
- Out of scope: Component restyling
- Preserve: Existing CSS rules


## Technical constraints
- tailwindcss ^3.4, postcss, autoprefixer


## Definition of done
- Configs exist and tests pass


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · cn helper and shadcn/Radix Button are available
nodes.body:
Context: no cn helper or shadcn components exist. Desired behavior: src/lib/utils.ts exports cn (clsx + tailwind-merge), components.json configures shadcn, and src/components/ui/button.tsx implements the shadcn Button using class-variance-authority and @radix-ui/react-slot. Expected result: reusable primitives for later slices.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given cn('px-2','px-4'), when called, then it returns 'px-4'
- Given cn('a', false && 'b', 'c'), when called, then it returns 'a c'
- Given Button with asChild wrapping an anchor, when rendered, then an anchor element carries the button classes
- Given Button variant default, when rendered, then it has the bg-primary class


## Scope
- In scope: package.json deps
- In scope: src/lib/utils.ts
- In scope: components.json
- In scope: src/components/ui/button.tsx
- Out of scope: Dialog, drawer, tabs components
- Preserve: Existing components


## Technical constraints
- clsx, tailwind-merge, class-variance-authority, @radix-ui/react-slot


## Definition of done
- Helper and Button exist and tests pass


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · GameLayout really uses Button, Lucide and Motion
nodes.body:
Context: GameLayout renders a plain button and aside. Desired behavior: the Story toggle is the shadcn Button with a Lucide ChevronUp icon (aria-hidden), and the aside is a motion.aside, with unchanged class names, aria-expanded and accessible name 'Story'. Expected result: lucide-react and motion are imported by shipped code.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given GameLayout, when rendered, then a button named 'Story' with aria-expanded 'false' exists and contains an svg icon
- Given the toggle clicked, when state flips, then aside has class drawer-open and aria-expanded is 'true'
- Given package.json, when read, then lucide-react and motion are dependencies
- Given the existing layout tests, when run, then they still pass


## Scope
- In scope: package.json
- In scope: src/components/GameLayout.tsx
- Out of scope: Other components
- Preserve: Class names game-layout, scene-area, story-panel, drawer-open


## Technical constraints
- Import motion from 'motion/react'


## Definition of done
- Layout uses stack and tests pass


## Clarifying questions
- None
